This first application has been filed by applicant under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.270/2024 registered at Police Station- Ambah,
District Morena (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376 of the IPC read with Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act and Section 3(1)(w)2d and 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST Act.
Applicant is in judicial custody since 10/06/2024.

As per the case of prosecution, mother of the prosecutrix reported to PS Ambah that her daughter,
aged around 16 years is missing since evening of 23/04/2024.
Some unknown person has enticed and taken her daughter.
On such allegations, PS Ambah, District Morena registered FIR at Crime No.270/2024 for offence punishable under Section 363 of the IPC.
Victim was recovered on 24/04/2024 on her appearance before PS Ambah.
In her statement recorded under Section 161 and 164 of the Cr.P.C, victim stated that child in conflict with law-"A" is her friend.
On 10/04/2024, she went to house of Kesh Kali (applicant ) who is paternal aunt of child in conflict with law-"A".
The child 2 MCRC-27784-2024 in conflict with law-"A"committed rape on her
at the house of applicant

. 
Applicant confined her and child in conflict with law-"A"in the room.
Mother of child in conflict with law-"A" initially promised to marry child in conflict with law-"A" with her but later they refused to marry him with her.
Thereafter, prosecution for offence punishable under Sections 366, 376 of the IPC read with Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act and Section 3(1)(w)(ii) and 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST Act was added.
Applicant was arrested on 10/06/2024, she is in custody ever since.
Investigation is complete.

sentences.text: It is a case of romantic relationship between two young persons.
When relation turned sour, allegation of sexually assault is levelled against child in conflict with law-"A"and she is falsely implicated in this matter.
Learned counsel further submits that applicant is aged 26 years.
She is homemaker and has family to look after.
There is no likelihood of his absconsion leaving his family and home.
No criminal antecedent is reported against the applicant There is no likelihood of tampering with the evidence, as both the parties belong to same socio economic status.
No custodial interrogation is needed in the matter.
The trial would take time to complete.
Therefore, applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
Per contra, learned Counsel for the State opposes the bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merits of the case, this 3 MCRC-27784-2024 Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Thus,
the application is allowed.
